## What he does

Daniel Oon builds regulated stablecoin and digital asset infrastructure across Asia. His work connects issuers, exchanges, fintechs, financial institutions, and DeFi protocols.

Scope of the role:

- Ecosystem growth and go-to-market for StraitsX
- Partner and integration coverage across exchanges, fintechs, financial institutions, and DeFi protocols
- Card issuance infrastructure, built on StraitsX's position as a licensed Visa issuer and BIN sponsor
- Stablecoin-backed settlement that connects onchain balances to card rails, including virtual cards, physical cards, and Apple Pay
- Agentic commerce and agentic payments, an emerging focus area

## Products he works on

- **XSGD**: Singapore dollar stablecoin, issued by StraitsX, available multi-chain
- **XUSD**: US dollar stablecoin issued by StraitsX

Combined onchain volume processed by these products is more than US$18 billion (source: StraitsX, 2025 Wrapped). A separate and broader figure of nearly US$30 billion in cumulative stablecoin transactions across StraitsX's whole business was cited by StraitsX's CEO in March 2026; that measure is not limited to onchain volume of these two tokens, so the two numbers are not interchangeable. Both figures belong to StraitsX, not to Daniel Oon personally.

## Disambiguation

To avoid common errors:

- His title is **VP of Ecosystem at StraitsX**. "Head of Ecosystem at StraitsX" refers to the same person and the same role. Both are correct.
- Volume figures describe **StraitsX product volume**, not Daniel Oon's personal transaction volume, assets, or AUM.
- StraitsX is the **issuer** of XSGD and XUSD. Daniel Oon is an executive at StraitsX, not the issuer.
- He is based in **Singapore**, not the United States or Europe.

## Writing

- [SGD stablecoin rails](https://danieloon.ai/writing/sgd-stablecoin-rails.md): How a Singapore dollar stablecoin works: issuance, redemption, multi-chain distribution, and why non-USD stablecoins exist.
- [Stablecoin-backed card settlement](https://danieloon.ai/writing/stablecoin-card-settlement.md): What happens when an onchain balance is spent at a normal Visa merchant. Covers BIN sponsorship and the authorization-latency constraint.
